title: dns: Improve SvcParam dissection, fix echconfig/odohconfig support
description:
* Use parameter names from draft-ietf-dnsop-svcb-https-01 to match the
  presentation format. Use keyNNNNN for unknown names in the tree.
* Remove the SvcParams tree and directly display parameters under the
  resource record tree. Include the parameter value as well.
* Add odohconfig (draft-pauly-dprive-oblivious-doh-02) support.
* Use the presentation format (base64) for echconfig/odohconfig values.
___
Before:
```
        wireshark.org: type HTTPS, class IN
            Name: wireshark.org
            Type: HTTPS (HTTPS Specific Service Endpoints) (65)
            ...
            SvcParams
                SvcParam: ALPN
                SvcParam: IPv4 Hint
                SvcParam: IPv6 Hint
```

After:
```
        wireshark.org: type HTTPS, class IN
            Name: wireshark.org
            Type: HTTPS (HTTPS Specific Service Endpoints) (65)
            ...
            SvcParam: alpn=h3-29,h3-28,h3-27,h2
            SvcParam: ipv4hint=104.26.10.240,104.26.11.240,172.67.75.39
            SvcParam: ipv6hint=2606:4700:20::681a:af0,2606:4700:20::681a:bf0,2606:4700:20::ac43:4b27
```
